fields.field: Reported clinical phenotypes in affected individuals, including verbatim wording from the paper and standard HPO term if identifiable
Phenotype frequencies with exact numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone)
Resolvable source citation (PMID or DOI) and cohort identification for every reported frequency
Most discriminating findings present in most affected individuals but uncommon in usually confused disorders
Names of overlapping disorders usually confused with Cornelia de Lange syndrome 6 and confidence level of the distinction
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals (findings that argue against the diagnosis)
Differences in phenotype by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Contradictory findings reported by one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
